name: Comic Con Brussels
blurb: Brussels' pop-culture convention at Tour & Taxis, bringing film and TV stars together with comics, manga and cosplay.

editions.evidence: Site footer text (rendered via /en/): 'TOUR & TAXIS - BRUSSELS Saturday 24th of October 2026 10:00-19:00h Sunday 25th of October 2026 10:00-17:00h'

notes: The site redirects almost every URL (home, homepage-en, guests) to itself with a client-side '?privacy=updated' reload that races the page-render tool's scroll/expand step and throws 'Cannot read properties of null (reading scrollHeight)' every time (tried default Chromium and --channel msedge, fresh and cached, on comicconbrussels.com/, /en/, /en/homepage-en/ and /en/guests/) — so no guest photo candidates or a clean homepage render could be captured; cover instead uses a transparent logo from a partially-rendered /en/ pass that did survive long enough to expose og/logo images and the dates footer. Per WebFetch (text-only, no images), the 2026 guests page lists 12 photo guests — David Harbour, Matt Smith, Miranda Otto, Bam Margera, Rory McCann, David Wenham, Anna Popplewell, Steven John Ward, Jenna Coleman, Mitchell Hope, Brenna D'Amico, Jedidiah Goodacre — plus 4 more slots marked TBA; recorded here as guests:"unavailable" since none of that could be confirmed through an actual image candidate as the picking process requires.
